title: Did AI Discover A New Gene-Editing Tool? The Anthropic Controversy Explained
hook_text: Did AI just build a gene tool?
script:
Anthropic used its Claude model to scan a massive DNA database.
The AI agents searched specifically for reverse transcriptase enzymes.
The process uncovered a system that closely resembles CRISPR gene editing.
Biologists previously used traditional laboratory methods to find these tools over decades.
Independent experts are now actively debating whether the AI output actually functions as claimed.
This breakthrough raises urgent biosecurity questions about automated biological discoveries.
Would you trust an AI to design new biological tools?
